name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3271: HEART: he reported that on windows and on grokbots linux there is no way to minimize or window the console - it opens fullscreen which he likes but fullscreen takes the titlebar with it everywhere except macOS, which keeps its own controls. The escape hatch was an env var readable only before launch. Now a window_action helper and api window route with two controls in the rail header, hidden where there is no native window to act on, and fullscreen stays the default he asked for. 7 red-proofs. REG-1081.
